Specification: This module specifies a Tendermint light client verification state machine together with an instantiated blockchain environment. The light client begins from a socially trusted block at TRUSTED_HEIGHT, fetches or reuses light blocks, verifies them via an external verification API, updates a light store and block-status map, and iterates until it either reaches TARGET_HEIGHT successfully or finishes with failure. The model includes clock drift between a local client clock and a reference blockchain clock, a primary that may be correct or faulty, and a faulty-validator ratio parameter; it defines many safety-style invariants about correctness, trust, and stored headers, as well as some expected-to-fail candidate properties and complexity/postcondition checks.
IfThenElse: IF height < ULTIMATE_HEIGHT THEN blockchain[height + 1].lastCommit ELSE blockchain[height].VS
IF IS_PRIMARY_CORRECT THEN CopyLightBlockFromChain(block, height) ELSE BC!IsLightBlockAllowedByDigitalSignatures(height, block)
IF h = ht THEN block ELSE lightBlocks[h]
IF h = ht THEN blockState ELSE statuses[h]
IF nextHeight \in DOMAIN fetchedLightBlocks THEN current = fetchedLightBlocks[nextHeight] ELSE FetchLightBlockInto(current, nextHeight)
CaseExpr: CASE verdict = "SUCCESS" -> /\ lightBlockStatus' = LightStoreUpdateStates(lightBlockStatus, nextHeight, "StateVerified") /\ latestVerified' = current /\ state' = IF latestVerified'.header.height < TARGET_HEIGHT THEN "working" ELSE "finishedSuccess" /\ \E newHeight \in HEIGHTS: /\ CanScheduleTo(newHeight, current, nextHeight, TARGET_HEIGHT) /\ nextHeight' = newHeight [] verdict = "NOT_ENOUGH_TRUST" -> /\ lightBlockStatus' = LightStoreUpdateStates(lightBlockStatus, nextHeight, "StateUnverified") /\ \E newHeight \in HEIGHTS: /\ CanScheduleTo(newHeight, latestVerified, nextHeight, TARGET_HEIGHT) /\ nextHeight' = newHeight /\ UNCHANGED <<latestVerified, state>> [] OTHER -> /\ lightBlockStatus' = LightStoreUpdateStates(lightBlockStatus, nextHeight, "StateFailed") /\ state' = "finishedFailure" /\ UNCHANGED <<latestVerified, nextHeight>>
FunctionConstructor: [h \in DOMAIN lightBlocks \union {ht} |-> IF h = ht THEN block ELSE lightBlocks[h]]
[h \in DOMAIN statuses \union {ht} |-> IF h = ht THEN blockState ELSE statuses[h]]
